notes:
Add a stable release channel, backup-first update script and admin update indicator

Students install once and need to update later without losing customer data.
Images now carry APP_VERSION; v* tags publish `stable` + `vX.Y.Z` images, a
GitHub Release and a latest.json feed in the public deploy repo.
deploy/update.sh backs up the database, wa-data and .env, pins rollback tags,
then pulls and health-checks, with --check and --rollback. The admin console
shows the running version and a banner when a newer release exists.
